scope: IF-001 was the concrete metadata omission; IF-005 records the lead-discovered compact-restoration generator issue. Their status reflects the current inspected version. Notices preserve reasonable file-level frame declarations; no current geometry correction was identified.

findings.fact: Eight bare PNG basenames have no declared base directory in the texture manifest. The generator explicitly loads them from its textures/ subdirectory. All actual files exist.
findings.proposed_change: Add a versioned texture-root/path-resolution declaration, preserving existing basenames, pixels, material roles and all source/GLB bytes. Refresh only affected metadata dependency bindings.
findings.resolution: Current texture manifest declares interface_revision=library-texture-paths-02, texture_root=textures, path_base=directory_containing_this_manifest and base_color_file_resolution=texture_root/base_color_file. The corresponding current generator reads that declaration.

findings.fact: Eight native GLBs retain origin/pivot prose describing Z-up/front -Y without an explicit source label. The paired manifests, catalogue coordinate contract and actual geometry clearly establish source Z-up and native GLB Y-up. This is not a geometry/frame failure and does not invalidate the corrected cabinet hinge.
findings.proposed_change: A versioned sidecar/current interface index should explicitly interpret these exact node extras as source-description text. Frozen GLBs need not change. Do not transform native GLB geometry twice.

findings.fact: Motion roots have export_group=static alongside kind=proposed_linear_removal_root. Actual DRIP_TRAY and RECEIVING_CADDY parent the intended moving material meshes and descendant markers. export_group is an authoring/consolidation tag, not an instruction to suppress the declared motion.
findings.proposed_change: Keep exact original records but state tag semantics in the normalized consumer map; use actual hierarchy and explicit motion kind/axis/travel. No need to rewrite native meshes.

findings.fact: Removable shelves, plate stacks and context tray are separable groups without a complete prescribed extraction trajectory for every group. Existing named tray/drawer translations and wheel axes are explicit.
findings.proposed_change: Mark unrestricted/removable-only groups as separable_geometry_trajectory_unspecified; do not invent clearance, grab points, motion limits or operating behavior. This is a semantic limit, not a requirement to add moving interfaces to static parts.

findings.fact: The lead isolated rebuild found the stock-variant generator assumed an existing qa/ output folder, which compact source packages omit. Current generator explicitly creates qa/ before writing its audit output.
findings.resolution: Current isolated generator report records both scripts exit0 and four byte-identical GLB outputs, while current visual masters remain unchanged. Auditor verified report inputs against current bytes; auditor did not execute the rebuild.

findings.fact: This is a mandatory output write in the invoked generation entrypoint, not a required QA input. A missing parent makes a source-only restored generator fail at the end of generation.
findings.resolution: Current generator explicitly creates the omitted QA output parent before its mandatory report write. This static guard check is separate from lead-run isolated rebuild evidence.

separate_lead_rebuild_evidence.attribution: Lead-run isolated rebuild; this auditor read and bound the report, did not execute it.
